fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon (AMZN) rose 4.8% in morning trading as JPMorgan designated it as top AI pick, with AWS revenue expected to grow over 40% in 2027–2028.
fields.summary_ko.1: AWS is projected to reach US$1 trillion in annual revenue within the next 5–10 years, with stock up 19% year-to-date and trading at US$269.47.
